info.title: NearGear — AI Treasury & Agent Security API
info.description:
Smart AI. Secure Treasury.

Businesses can give AI agents permission to spend money, but NearGear makes sure they spend only within the rules established by the business.

### Core Security Permissions:
1. **Approved Recipient Permission**: Autonomous agents can only disburse payments to wallet addresses pre-approved by the treasury owner (e.g. paying approved cloud hosting or APIs, rejecting unknown recipients).
2. **Transaction Approval Permission**: Payments at or below the instant threshold (e.g. 5 NEAR) are auto-approved; payments above require human owner approval.
3. **Task-Based Permission**: Agents can only spend on authorized task and service categories (e.g. cloud_hosting, research_apis, compute_resources).
4. **Time-Based Permission**: Agents can only initiate disbursements during authorized operating windows (e.g. 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM UTC, Mon-Fri).

### Additional Capabilities:
- **Multi-Wallet NEAR Authentication**: Universal support for Meteor Wallet, Sender Wallet, Here Wallet, MyNearWallet, and NEAR Mobile (Ed25519 & NEP-413 signatures).
- **Real-Time Telegram Notifications**: Instant alert dispatch via Telegram Bot to treasury owners and support groups on all agent disbursements, approval requests, and policy violations.
- **Multi-Asset Treasury Management**: Live NEAR & NEP-141 token tracking on NEAR Testnet and Mainnet.
- **On-Chain TreasuryVault Smart Contract**: Verifiable smart contract enforcement on NEAR Protocol.
- **Rule Engine & Outlier Anomaly Detection**: Comprehensive pre-execution evaluation for agent operations.
- **Grounded AI Treasury Copilot**: Groq / LLaMA 3.3 powered natural language treasury management.
